name: Jabberwocky
description: A toolhead and extruder system designed specifically for filament changing units (FCUs) and multicolor changers. Features a tool-free hinged extruder mechanism for fast maintenance, a Bondtech compound drive gear with dual LDO Orbiter gears, and integrated dual filament sensors for reliable filament change cycles.
features: Tool-free hinged extruder for fast maintenance
Bondtech compound drive gear with dual LDO Orbiter gears
Dual filament sensors for monitoring filament supply
Integrated filament cutter with support bearings
Compatible with ERCF and Box Turtle filament changers
Available as complete assembled kit or basic hardware kit
